drafts.title: A New Page
drafts.description: This world is considerably larger than it first appears. You do not need to learn everything today; you only need a reason to take the next step.
drafts.objective: Read the first entry in your Adventure Journal.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Your discoveries and encounters will open more journeys. The detailed Field Manual is separate.
drafts.verification_note: Always available on first joining.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Journal of Your Own
drafts.description: Quests here follow the adventures you choose. Some are invitations rather than instructions; an unfamiliar ruin does not demand you conquer it immediately.
drafts.objective: Open this entry and learn how optional chapters appear.
drafts.field_manual_hint: The journal records your story; it is not a checklist you must finish before exploring freely.
drafts.verification_note: Read-once intro; do not repeatedly toast.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Field Manual
drafts.description: A good explorer knows where to look for answers. The Field Manual contains the detailed explanations that would interrupt an adventure.
drafts.objective: Read how to open the FTB Field Manual when you need it.
drafts.field_manual_hint: The Adventure Journal is for goals; the Field Manual is for mechanics, recipes and examples.
drafts.verification_note: No reliable direct open-FTB objective established; optional reading.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Recipe Beneath the Recipe
drafts.description: A strange item is a question, not a dead end. Many useful materials become obvious once you know what they are used for.
drafts.objective: Learn how to inspect an item's recipes and uses through JEI.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Use the recipe and uses shortcuts shown in the Field Manual; exact keybinds can be remapped.
drafts.verification_note: No documented Questlog objective for opening JEI recipe screen; educational only.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Behind the Shield
drafts.description: An axe or sword can win a quick encounter; a shield may let you survive an unfamiliar one. Defense is worth more than one extra hit when you don't know the enemy.
drafts.objective: Obtain a shield and try blocking a safe attack.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Hold it in your off-hand and use its action key; some modded attacks may bypass a shield.
drafts.verification_note: Use vanilla shield ID only for possession, never claim blocking proved.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Stronger Than Bare Hands
drafts.description: Armor is your allowance for mistakes. Even ordinary pieces are worthwhile when your next cave contains creatures you have never seen.
drafts.objective: Equip a useful piece of armor.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Begin with any armor that fits your playstyle. Rare items are not necessary for the first expedition.
drafts.verification_note: Any vanilla armor slot allowed. Do not enforce full matching set.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Provisions for the Road
drafts.description: The first rule of a long expedition is to return from it. Take more food than you expect to need; it is much harder to gather when danger is already chasing you.
drafts.objective: Obtain a small supply of food before venturing far.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Cooked food lasts longer than relying on whatever you find underground. Exact amount will be set during balance QA.
drafts.verification_note: Select flexible edible tag/OR objectives after ingredient availability test.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Marker Left Behind
drafts.description: Defeat is part of discovery. Before traveling, understand what happens to equipment when you die and how your recovery system works.
drafts.objective: Read the death-recovery page in the Field Manual.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Do not gamble an irreplaceable item until you know your world's grave and recovery rules.
drafts.verification_note: Do not promise particular tombstone behavior without exact current config.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Pack for the Journey
drafts.description: New loot is most useful when you can carry it home. An extra bag also makes it easier to separate emergency gear from what you hope to sell or study.
drafts.objective: Obtain a starter backpack or other suitable portable storage.
drafts.field_manual_hint: See the Field Manual for upgrades, filters and how the backpack interacts with your inventory.
drafts.verification_note: Resolve Sophisticated Backpacks and alternate carry-items before deciding OR predicate.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Mark the Way Home
drafts.description: The world is easy to lose yourself in. A single marked shelter or Waystone can turn an uncertain journey into a repeatable route.
drafts.objective: Learn how to mark an important place on your map.
drafts.field_manual_hint: A waypoint does not mean your character is safe. Keep track of portals and the path back, too.
drafts.verification_note: Xaero actions may need custom integration; educational completion only initially.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Roof Among Strangers
drafts.description: Settlements are places to rest, trade and gather information. They are also worth returning to when a future adventure takes you through familiar country.
drafts.objective: Find a settlement or establish a safe home base.
drafts.field_manual_hint: A naturally generated village is one option; your own protected shelter should also satisfy the spirit of this milestone.
drafts.verification_note: Do not gate mainline on any specific village structure ID or forced travel.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Chest for Every Explorer
drafts.description: In a multiplayer dungeon, one player's discovery should not necessarily empty the rewards for everyone else. Some containers are personal; others are shared.
drafts.objective: Read the Lootr and chest-sharing explanation.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Ask before taking the last shared item. Individual loot containers may look different from ordinary chests.
drafts.verification_note: No automatic loot claim required; preserve fair multiplayer etiquette.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Know Your Equipment
drafts.description: Your armor is not your whole defense. Rings, charms and unusual relics can change how you survive a battle—but some compete for the same equipment slot.
drafts.objective: Read the basic combat-support and equipment-slot guide.
drafts.field_manual_hint: The strength of a support depends on when its effect activates, not just how impressive its name sounds.
drafts.verification_note: Reference Gear Atlas; verify Curios/Accessories slots.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Where the Grass Changes
drafts.description: Beyond the safety of your first camp, the world changes. The next landscape may have new wildlife, unfamiliar materials and a new kind of danger.
drafts.objective: Discover a biome you have not visited before.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Only naturally visited, enabled biomes should count in the future Explorer's Journal.
drafts.verification_note: A generated biome checklist can record first visits; Questlog no universal new-biome objective.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Different Horizon
drafts.description: A forest, a rocky peak and a wetland are not interchangeable places. Learning to recognize a region will matter when searching for unusual creatures and ruins.
drafts.objective: Explore a contrasting landscape or biome family.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Any suitable climate family should count; avoid sending a new player across thousands of blocks by chance.
drafts.verification_note: Biome-family OR objective depends on validated active tags/registry.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Shape of the World
drafts.description: Not every great discovery contains a loot chest. A valley, a natural arch or a towering cliff can be worth recording simply because it exists.
drafts.objective: Record a remarkable natural location.
drafts.field_manual_hint: For procedural terrain, use an opt-in journal mark or screenshot—not a fabricated structure detector.
drafts.verification_note: Never hard-require a mathematically arbitrary scenic viewpoint.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Stones That Outlasted Their Builders
drafts.description: Ruins are signs that someone—or something—was here before you. Most are safe enough to investigate cautiously; a few are warnings.
drafts.objective: Discover a minor ruin, small tower or other notable landmark.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Do not assume every tower is safe. Look for mobs, traps or an obvious entrance before rushing inside.
drafts.verification_note: Use a list of actual common structure IDs, plus safe alternate proof.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Ruin Is Not a Dungeon
drafts.description: One abandoned house may hold a little loot. Another structure can contain several floors of enemies and a boss. Knowing the difference is an exploration skill.
drafts.objective: Read the danger-rating system used in the AO Atlas.
drafts.field_manual_hint: A location's tier means recommended preparation, not that you are forbidden to enter.
drafts.verification_note: Pure learning objective; no need for registered structure.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Beneath the Surface
drafts.description: The stone under your feet hides materials, creatures, old corridors and even entire unfamiliar habitats. Bring light and a way back.
drafts.objective: Explore beneath the surface and safely return.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Avoid a depth-only task that rewards digging a hole. Prefer a normal cave expedition or accepted exploration milestone.
drafts.verification_note: A generic arbitrary cave visit is not a reliable Questlog structure objective.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: An Edge Worth Carrying
drafts.description: There is no perfect weapon for every threat. A sturdy blade, a spear or a ranged choice can each be useful depending on what you're facing.
drafts.objective: Upgrade to a reliable primary weapon.
drafts.field_manual_hint: A diamond weapon is an early benchmark, not a permanent ban on alternative modded weapons.
drafts.verification_note: Accept comparable modded weapon alternatives after tier calibration.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Small Advantage
drafts.description: The first helpful charm or artifact will teach you something about your build. Look for effects you can actually notice while exploring.
drafts.objective: Find and try a travel or utility accessory.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Check whether the item needs equipping, charging or activating; picking one up may not reveal its function.
drafts.verification_note: True equipped-state proof may require custom accessories integration.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Somewhere Worth Remembering
drafts.description: Good explorers recognize the places they will want to revisit. A strange tower that is too dangerous today may become tomorrow's destination.
drafts.objective: Save a discovered location for a later expedition.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Use an existing map waypoint; never reveal the coordinates of places you have not found yourself.
drafts.verification_note: Waypoint event not supported natively; instruct and complete by reading.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Return Journey
drafts.description: The trip home is part of the expedition. With an established route, distance becomes an opportunity rather than a risk.
drafts.objective: Establish a reliable return route or activate a Waystone.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Carry supplies for the return trip. A Waystone is helpful, but not every expedition starts near one.
drafts.verification_note: Avoid requiring an exact Waystone ID if travel system changes.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Explorer's Record
drafts.description: A world this large deserves a record. You should be able to see what you have discovered without remembering every biome name yourself.
drafts.objective: Learn how your personal Explorer's Journal tracks discoveries.
drafts.field_manual_hint: The checklist records visits; finding a dungeon does not mean its boss has been defeated.
drafts.verification_note: Journal UI not selected/installed; keep as hidden until engine chosen.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Shape of Danger
drafts.description: A massive citadel and a quiet roadside ruin should never feel equally threatening. Learn when to step inside—and when to return later.
drafts.objective: Consult the difficulty guidance for a discovered major structure.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Look at armor, support items and environmental hazards together. Retreating is preparation, not failure.
drafts.verification_note: Cross-link Boss Atlas once that location has a validated tier.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Diamond Foundation
drafts.description: The first demanding battles will punish weak armor. Diamonds are not the end of the journey, but they offer a reliable starting point.
drafts.objective: Assemble a full set of diamond-grade armor.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Vanilla diamond or genuinely equivalent tested armor should qualify; avoid strict item-only restrictions on viable builds.
drafts.verification_note: Questlog cannot directly inspect whole equipment profile as one predicate without bridge.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Protection Is a Decision
drafts.description: Armor makes room for mistakes, and enchantments make room for bigger ones. For the coming trials, enchantments matter as much as raw armor value.
drafts.objective: Bring your protection to approximately Protection III across your diamond armor.
drafts.field_manual_hint: AO's Tier 2 benchmark is enchanted diamond at roughly Protection III; do not require identical enchantments if equivalent protection exists.
drafts.verification_note: Requires full gear/enchantment equivalence policy and custom verification.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Choose Your Weapon
drafts.description: A good weapon is not simply the one with the highest damage number. Reach, speed, spells and special effects all change how it handles danger.
drafts.objective: Equip a reliable weapon suited to a major encounter.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Try it against ordinary enemies before committing to a dungeon with unfamiliar mechanics.
drafts.verification_note: Allow swords, bows and spellbooks/alternatives; never lock one class.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Hidden Strength
drafts.description: Combat accessories turn ordinary equipment into a build. Some reward aggressive attacks, some save you from mistakes, and others help you move.
drafts.objective: Read how A-grade combat-support items are evaluated in the Gear Atlas.
drafts.field_manual_hint: An item belongs in A grade because it meaningfully helps in combat, not because its rarity looks impressive.
drafts.verification_note: A/EX grade source is AO provisional Gear Atlas; verify versions.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The First Reliable Companion
drafts.description: An accessory with a dependable effect is worth more than a collection of curios you never use. Choose one that suits your preferred way to fight.
drafts.objective: Equip one compatible A-grade combat-support item.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Read the item's tooltip: does it trigger passively, on hit, on damage, or after a cooldown?
drafts.verification_note: Curios/Relics equipped-state not covered by vanilla Questlog item_equip slots.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Second Layer of Defense
drafts.description: A single charm can save you once. Two carefully chosen supports can cover different weaknesses—if you can equip them together.
drafts.objective: Equip two simultaneously usable A-grade combat-support items.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Two items in the same slot do not count as a two-item loadout. Avoid counting EX-grade effects until balanced.
drafts.verification_note: Tier 2 user-required threshold. Cross-check actual slot exclusivity.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: What Fits Together
drafts.description: Two powerful items are not always stronger together. They can compete for a slot, overwrite an effect or multiply into something that needs rebalancing.
drafts.objective: Review the slots and mechanics of your current combat supports.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Open the Gear Atlas if you need to compare activated and passive effects.
drafts.verification_note: Never grant equivalent power via Origin/class passives.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Door That Feels Too Heavy
drafts.description: Major dungeons leave a different impression from ordinary ruins. Finding one is a discovery in itself—even if today you only mark its entrance.
drafts.objective: Discover one appropriate Tier 2 major dungeon or dangerous landmark.
drafts.field_manual_hint: You can return later. The discovery records where the next challenge lies, not whether you won.
drafts.verification_note: Require natural registered location from actual AO Atlas; choose several alternatives.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Before the First Step Inside
drafts.description: Take a moment to prepare. Food, armor, escape options and information are easier to gather outside than inside a boss arena.
drafts.objective: Read the equipment and hazard recommendations for your selected dungeon.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Your recommended tier is a guideline; a clever build still needs survivability and familiarity with the enemy.
drafts.verification_note: Cross-link to verified boss dossier, don't spoil loot prematurely.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Your First Great Test
drafts.description: You have learned how to travel, survive and improve your equipment. Now use those skills in a challenge that actually asks something of you.
drafts.objective: Overcome one approved Tier 2 dungeon or miniboss encounter.
drafts.field_manual_hint: You can choose from several encounters. The main campaign must not depend on finding one ultra-rare boss.
drafts.verification_note: Need whitelist of validated Tier 2 boss IDs and party credit policy.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Found, Fought, Finished
drafts.description: Entering a ruined fortress is one achievement. Defeating its guardian is another. Finding every secret is a third, entirely optional goal.
drafts.objective: Read how discovery, conquest and mastery are tracked separately.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Mastery is an optional bonus; it should never block normal chapter progression.
drafts.verification_note: Journal found/cleared/mastered state planned, not implemented.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The World Opens Wider
drafts.description: The next chapters will introduce stranger lands and harder enemies. You already know the important part: choose your own route, and prepare for what you find.
drafts.objective: Complete the Tier 2 preparation and encounter milestone, then choose an optional expedition.
drafts.field_manual_hint: No single modded dimension is required to continue. Your character's path is yours to shape.
drafts.verification_note: Only complete when actual previous quest verified, allow alternative Tier 2 encounters.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Within main chapter, educational steps are skippable and alternatives retained
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Peculiar Invitation
drafts.description: Some items appear ordinary until you learn what they are willing to do for you. Enigmatic artifacts reward curiosity, but not every mystery asks for a sacrifice.
drafts.objective: Read the introductory notes on Enigmatic Legacy's artifacts.
drafts.field_manual_hint: This path is separate from the Seven Curses route. You do not need to equip the cursed ring.
drafts.verification_note: Normal route independent of cursed flags.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Choice Not Yet Made
drafts.description: The first useful relic should teach you how unusual equipment works before you make riskier decisions. Read its effect, slot and limits carefully.
drafts.objective: Inspect one accessible non-cursed enigmatic relic.
drafts.field_manual_hint: An item's presence in JEI does not prove it is accessible without the cursed ring; verify crafting and drops.
drafts.verification_note: Must source-check actual obtainable Enigmatic Legacy Plus 1.1.2 item.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Warning on the Ring
drafts.description: Some bargains are not meant to be undone. The Seven Curses route is available to those who deliberately want a harsher game, not a rite of passage for every adventurer.
drafts.objective: Read the full risk notice before deciding whether to proceed.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Nothing in the main campaign requires this ring. Choosing not to wear it will not close other quests.
drafts.verification_note: No auto-equip, no forced cursed state; warn about permanence where verified.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: An Unclaimed Oath
drafts.description: Possessing an object and accepting its terms are different choices. The journal will never treat picking up the ring as consent.
drafts.objective: Learn how this mod distinguishes holding the ring from activating its curse.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Keep normal artifact progression available whether or not the player chooses this branch.
drafts.verification_note: User must explicitly opt in outside Questlog; do not award/force ring equip.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Shape of a Dream
drafts.description: Beyond familiar terrain lies a world that does not follow familiar rules. Before crossing into it, find out which dreams are actually reachable in this version.
drafts.objective: Investigate the documented route into the Dreamscape.
drafts.field_manual_hint: This entry will stay hidden until the pinned NeoPasterDream 0.9.6 realm access is verified.
drafts.verification_note: Dream entry method must be confirmed from JAR/config not inferred from modern wiki.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The First Dreamseeker
drafts.description: Strange dimensions deserve patient explorers. If you find a Dreamseeker note, pay attention: it may be explaining a system you will need much later.
drafts.objective: Find and read a real Dreamseeker note or journal item.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Notes are only valid quest targets once their item IDs and obtainable locations are confirmed.
drafts.verification_note: Replace with exact note when verified.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Colors Beyond the World
drafts.description: A dream realm is more than a different sky. Its terrain, resources and inhabitants may reward a different way of traveling and fighting.
drafts.objective: Make your first verified Dreamscape biome discovery.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Never send players to later-release regions that do not exist in AO's 0.9.6 binary.
drafts.verification_note: Verify dimension/biome registries in actual build.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: The Sea Has Teeth
drafts.description: A cold sea can conceal far more than ice and wreckage. Pack for the journey, and assume that the first strange shape beneath the water is a warning.
drafts.objective: Read the Frozen Seas preparation guide.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Bring a safe return method. Swimming deeper is not the same as being ready for the thing living below.
drafts.verification_note: Aquamirae available in Test8.2, exact AO tier pending combat calibration.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Walls of Ice
drafts.description: A maze in the frozen ocean is a discovery, even when you only survive its outskirts. Map an entrance before you risk diving farther.
drafts.objective: Locate the Ice Maze through natural exploration.
drafts.field_manual_hint: The Ice Maze must resolve to a real registered structure or custom verified location trigger.
drafts.verification_note: Verify Aqam. 7.2.10 structure key and biome eligibility.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Page of Spells
drafts.description: Magic does not begin with spectacular damage. It begins with a book, a simple glyph and the ability to combine effects deliberately.
drafts.objective: Acquire your first usable Ars Nouveau spellbook.
drafts.field_manual_hint: The Field Manual explains glyph syntax step by step. This adventure only tracks the major milestone.
drafts.verification_note: Verify Ars version and acceptable starter spellbook IDs.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Ink, Paper, Power
drafts.description: The first spell you cast will not be the strongest one you ever know. Learning what a spell costs is just as valuable as learning what it does.
drafts.objective: Acquire a usable spellbook for Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Start with a spell you can reliably cast and recharge. Look up spell schools in the Field Manual.
drafts.verification_note: Verify current tier of spellbooks and player access; no class requirement.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: A Forest Out of Place
drafts.description: Some forests do not belong to this world. Their paths branch toward ruins and creatures that expect preparation rather than courage alone.
drafts.objective: Learn how to enter the Twilight Forest.
drafts.field_manual_hint: Do not assume the first boss is optional to a specific Twilight portal progression gate until verified.
drafts.verification_note: Portal recipe and progression require exact installed mod audit.
drafts.prerequisite_policy: Optional discoverable branch; never gates mainline
drafts.reward_status: Unassigned; balance after live trigger validation

drafts.title: Eyes from Many Roads
drafts.description: Reaching the End should feel like the result of several adventures, not a single uninteresting shopping list. The paths to an Eye are meant to differ.
drafts.objective: Read how the pack's End Remastered eye collection works.
